tools.name: search_ai_tools
tools.description: Search the AISOTools catalog of AI tools by keyword, category slug, and pricing model. Returns ranked summaries with the canonical aisotools.com page for each result. Use it when the user asks which AI tool does something. `matched` is how many tools matched in total and `returned` is how many came

tools.name: get_ai_tool
tools.description: Full catalog record for one AI tool: description, features, pros, cons, who it is best for, pricing tiers, and alternatives. Accepts a slug or a display name.

tools.name: list_ai_tool_categories
tools.description: Every category in the AISOTools catalog with its slug, subcategories, and how many tools it contains.

tools.name: compare_ai_tools
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2-5 AI tools: pricing, rating, features, pros and cons. Use it when the user is choosing between named products.

tools.name: find_ai_tool_alternatives
tools.description: Alternatives to a given AI tool, drawn from the catalog's curated alternative lists and falling back to same-category tools. Use it when the user wants to replace or switch off a product.

tools.name: check_ai_visibility
tools.description: Use this when the user wants to know whether AI assistants recommend their product, brand or app — for example 'does ChatGPT mention my product?' or 'which competitors does ChatGPT suggest instead of us?'. findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "search_ai_tools" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Search the AISOTools catalog of AI tools by keyword, category slug, and pricing model. Returns ranked summaries with the canonical aisotools.com page for each r…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "search_ai_tools" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Search the AISOTools catalog of AI tools by keyword, category slug, and pricing model. Returns ranked summaries with the canonical aisotools.com page for each r…

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_ai_tools" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
